jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role

Are you an experienced accounting professional with a strong background in General Ledger processes and process automation? Join our team as a Business Process Expert (all genders) and contribute your expertise to improving financial processes, driving automation, and ensuring effective governance across the organization. In this role, you will perform regular Business Process Expert tasks, including control design and governance, KPI review, automation and governance, develop and maintain global work instructions and procedures, as well as conduct training for subject matter experts. You will improve financial processes within General Ledger and ensure processes comply with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). You will collaborate with auditors during internal and external audits, define and set automation rules, assist the technical team during configuration and implementation stages, work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth integration and manage changes across the organization, and support the BPO and Team Lead with ad-hoc requests and project tasks.

This position is limited to 2 years.

Who you are

- You have 5+ years of experience in accounting or finance roles and hold a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CPA or ICA are highly desirable.
- You possess strong process improvement skills and hands-on experience with process automation for Record-to-Report (R2R), General Ledger Accounting Process, including tools and methodologies, and have extensive knowledge of ERP systems, particularly SAP S/4 HANA or SAP ECC.
- You understand core accounting processes, including Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Asset Accounting (AA), General Ledger (GL), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Accounts Payable (AP).
- You have participated in large-scale transformation projects and can design and document comprehensive accounting processes with a focus on compliance and efficiency.
- You excel in dynamic environments, demonstrating adaptability and a positive attitude.
- You are proficient in Microsoft Office and have experience with data visualization and reporting tools; Experience with Redwood (RunmyFinance) or Blackline Finance Automation is an advantage.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are essential.
- PMO exposure or experience supporting project governance, reporting, and process improvement; familiarity with PMO tools and methodologies is a plus.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

This role is a core position in our Finance organization. As a Business Controller, you will be responsible to financially control the strategy and execution of a Business Group. Acting as a true business partner, your core tasks will compromise revenue and margin steering, the financial evaluation of development or cost improvement projects, as well as supporting activities during month-end closure or financial planning of the Business Group Bipolar Discretes. Furthermore, this role focuses on improving operational effectiveness and efficiency of financial processes in the Business Group.

In this exciting role, you will be in the middle of different financial processes within the international organization of Nexperia. Eagerness, pro-activeness, being self-critical, accuracy and a positive drive are the essential behavioural aspects we are searching for.

- Expert in Analytics and Accuracy

- Creativity and individual problem-solving skills
- Ability to work independently and under pressure
- Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

We are a research, development, and production site in Bremen, currently with about 500 employees, whose “high-end” measurement and analysis instruments (mass spectrometers) are used in research and science worldwide. Join our Technical Support team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to groundbreaking scientific research and innovation. Provide expert technical support for Thermo Fisher Scientific Gas Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometry products, working closely with customers, Field Service Engineers, and internal factory departments to resolve technical issues, support installations and maintenance, deliver training, and drive continuous product quality improvements.

- Provide support to Service Engineers during installations, repairs, and maintenance
- Collaborate closely with the Field Service Organization in various aspects

- Report problems from the field to relevant departments of the factory (Quality, R&D, Parts & Repair) to drive quality improvements and contribute to finding solutions and implementing them in the field

Keys to Success:
Education

- Professional background with a graduate-level qualification or equivalent vocational experience in Electronics, Science, and/or Physics; an electronic engineering degree is a clear advantage.

Experience

- Experience troubleshooting electronic systems is a clear advantage
- Technical experience with Thermo Fisher Scientific Orbitrap and GIRMS Mass Spectrometers is an advantage
- Experience in providing trainings or workshops is an advantage

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Customer-focused with a strong commercial understanding
- Proactive and organized, with a keen interest in self-education and systematic work
- Ability to quickly understand problems and work systematically towards solutions
- Good understanding and experience with Microsoft Office Applications
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
- Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with sophisticated scientific equipment and software

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

jobs.occupation: Doctoral research associate for BabylAXO detector development (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Doctoral research associate for BabylAXO detector development

Limited: 3 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FHDO021/2026 | Deadline: 02.11.2026 | Full-time/Part‑time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Cluster of Excellence "Quantum Universe" performs research to understand mass and gravity at the interface between quantum physics and cosmology. The research team includes leading scientists from mathematics, particle physics, astrophysics, and cosmology at the University of Hamburg and DESY. As part of the cluster's experimental program to search for hypothetical very lightweight bosons, for example motivated by dark matter and dark energy in the universe, the construction of the BabylAXO experiment will start shortly. BabylAXO will look for axions and similar particles emitted by the sun in uncharted parameter regions. The doctoral research associate will engage in the start-up phase of BabylAXO and work on the extension of its scientific portfolio.

The successful applicant will be attached to the ALPS group at DESY, which together with international partners is realizing new experimental facilities to search for new kinds of very lightweight elementary particles, works on new concepts targeting high-frequency gravitational waves and developing related technologies. Doctoral research associates will become members of the Quantum Universe Research School (QURS), which provides academic and key skills training, as well as career planning support. In addition, they will receive individual budgets to facilitate the attendance of summer schools and conferences, and to support other educational measures. Additional travel money for project-specific duties will be provided by the hosting research groups. Doctoral researchers may participate in teaching at the University and in the organization of the Cluster via an early career council.

About your role:

- Contribute to the commission and installation of the BabylAXO X-ray detection systems
- Develop a calorimeter for BabylAXO sensitive to axions from solar fusion processes and supernova explosions
- Explore synergies of the calorimeter development with medical applications

About you:

- MSc degree in Physics or equivalent qualification
- Hands-on experience in the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of complex experimental setups
- Programming experience in scientific computing environments
- Independent, proactive, and goal-oriented working style with a strong commitment to solving complex technical challenges
- Excellent written and spoken English skills
- Experience in detector development for or operation of experimental particle physics or dark matter search experiments

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work‑life balance, we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Axel Lindner at +49 40 8998‑3525 (https://tel:+494089983525) (axel.lindner@desy.de (axel.lindner@desy.de) ).

DESY in Hamburg does not grant doctoral degrees directly but collaborates with the University of Hamburg. Candidates for thesis research will have to satisfy the terms of admission for doctoral theses of the University of Hamburg. PhD students receive a monthly salary of 67% of the payment of the remuneration group 13 TVöD (Federal Government).

The research group „Structure and Function of Molecular Machines“ headed by Prof. Dr. Hauke Hillen at the Institute of Cellular Biochemistry is inviting applications for a 

PhD Student (f/m/d)

- Molecular & structural biology of organellar gene expression -

About us

Our group is located at the University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) and at the Max-Planck-Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences in Göttingen, Germany. Our research is aimed at understanding the mechanisms of eukaryotic gene expression system, in particular those found in organelles (mitochondria and chloroplasts) or employed by viruses. To study these systems, we combine structural biology (single-particle cryo-electron microscopy, X-Ray crystallography and cryo-electron tomography) with biochemical, biophysical and cell biological approaches. For recent examples of our work, see PMID: 34489609, 34135319, 38428434, 39747487, 40050611 and 40240327.

We offer access to state-of-the art instrumentation for cryo-EM (including two 300 kV Titan Krios TEMs, a 200 kV Glacios TEM and two Aquilos 2 FIB-SEMs as well as correlative fluorescent and light microscopy devices), X-Ray crystallography and various modern biophysical techniques. Göttingen is a vibrant, international student town located in the center of Germany and, in addition to its university, is home to a number of renowned research institutes, which together form the Göttingen Research Campus.
 
Position details

The position is fixed term (3 years) and the salary will be in accordance to the German Public Sector Collective Agreement (TV-L). The position is to be filled as soon as possible. The UMG is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals. We further strive for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

How to apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. To apply, please submit a single PDF containing a short statement of motivation and previous experience, a CV, and the names and contacts of at least two references through the system. 

For more information, visit our lab website: http://hillenlab.uni-goettingen.de

Your tasks

· Combine cutting-edge structural biology, protein- and RNA biochemistry as well as cellular methods to dissect mitochondrial molecular biology from the atomic to the organellar scale
· Drive your own research project in a collaborative team with close mentoring and supervision
· Present & communicate research results at national and international scientific meetings
· Gain experience in mentoring and teaching of students

Your qualifications

· Applicants should hold a M.Sc. or equivalent degree in biochemistry or a related discipline
· Previous experience in structural biology, protein- or RNA biochemistry is advantageous
· Fluent English language skills (written and spoken) are required

We offer

· High-impact research field with biomedical relevance
· Small, international and diverse research group with a strong team spirit and an open-minded, collaborative and respectful working atmosphere
· Access to state-of-the-art infrastructure & hands-on training in latest methods in molecular biology and structural biology methods
· Structured cross-institutional graduate program that offers numerous mentoring and career support opportunities

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

FLASH is DESY's (and the world's first) free-electron laser user facility. Within the FLASH2020+ project, the multi-beamline FEL facility FLASH has upgraded its primary arm, FLASH1, to accommodate the first externally seeded beamline, with a 1 MHz repetition rate in burst mode. We also adapt the diagnostics on both the photon and electron beam sides to match this goal. Stability is a key factor. A stable seeded source opens the door to many new experiments. Through the ErUM-Data and LEAPS-funded proposals, we develop resource-efficient and reliable Al and machine learning methods to advance ML for photon science applications while keeping large-scale research more sustainable. We are looking for a motivated postdoc to join the team and take an essential role in advancing the capabilities of FLASH with a focus on the externally seeded FLASH1 FEL branch.

About your role:

- Investigation of the coherent properties of undulator and FEL radiation with particular emphasis on transverse and spatial coherence
- Development of machine-learning-based methods to characterize (coherent) FEL radiation and deduce electron-beam properties using non-invasive single-shot photon diagnostics
- Enhance photon diagnostic capabilities, e.g. with respect to performance on ultrashort pulses
- Integration of the developed methods into the existing FLASH diagnostic infrastructure with the aim of providing non-invasive electron-beam diagnostics and supporting beam matching and optimization
- Support of FLASH operation and participation in dedicated experiments when appropriate
- Presentation of the achieved results in scientific journals and at international conferences

About you:

- PhD or equivalent, preferably with expertise in FEL physics, accelerator physics, or related field(s)
- Strong background in physics of coherent electromagnetic radiation
- Experience with machine-learning techniques and their application to partially or fully coherent x-ray sources
- Motivation to develop diagnostic methods, concepts, or instruments for the characterization of photon pulses
- Experience with Benchmarking theory against modeled or experimental data at light-source facilities as well as experience with numerical simulations using FEL and accelerator simulation tools (e.g. GENESIS, Elegant, or equivalent) are advantageous
- Good command of high-level scripting languages (Python/Matlab) is essential
- Good command of English
- Excellent teamwork abilities in an international environment

jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoctoral researcher for X‑ray microscopy at atomic resolution

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FSPO009/2026 | Deadline: 20.10.2026 |

Full-time/Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Advanced Multilayer X‑ray Optics group at CFEL is one of the leading research groups developing novel X‑ray lenses, also known as multilayer Laue lenses (MLLs). We plan to further improve and extend MLLs as part of a large project to image, understand and ultimately control electron dynamics in molecular systems. To do this, we are combining concepts from X-ray microscopy, crystallography, and ultrafast X‑ray science. Here is an opportunity for a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to be part of our team and this exciting project.

About your role:

- Prepare and conduct scientific experiments at various X‑ray facilities (synchrotrons and XFELs)
- Develop and apply techniques to characterize and improve X‑ray lenses (MLLs) and gratings
- Extend and improve X‑ray imaging modalities towards atomic resolution
- Explore the feasibility of MLLs for various experiments and for their increased use at lab, synchrotron and XFEL sources
- Communicate findings via publications and presentations

About you:

- PhD in physics, applied physics or a related field
- Sound knowledge of Fourier optics, X-ray physics, and metrology
- Experience in experimental methods or development of instrumentation
- Experience with synchrotron and XFEL experiments is an advantage
- Good programming skills, especially in Python
- Proficient in English and in writing scientific articles
